title: Crystal Clear Bar Salts Passionfruit Orange Guava Nic Salts 10ml E-Liquid
description: Crystal Clear Passionfruit Orange Guava Nic Salt brings together three bold fruits for a tropical vape with plenty of depth. Passionfruit adds fragrance and sweetness, Orange brings zest and brightness, and Guava offers mellow softness. A fruit blend with vibrant character. Formulated at a 50VG/50PG ratio, this Nic Salt e-liquid is ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping using pod kits and vape pens. Choose from 10mg and 20mg strengths for a smooth throat hit and quick nicotine delivery. Crystal Clear Nic Salts are crafted to deliver the same great-tasting flavours that made disposable vapes so popular, now reimagined for refillable pod kits. Designed for clarity, consistency and convenience, this UK-made range focuses on fruity, icy, and confectionery-inspired blends that cater to everyday vapers.
